title.en: An Act Creating the Barrios of Santa Clara and Cunig in the Municipalities of Gonzaga and Gattaran, Respectively, Province of Cagayan
title.orig: An Act Creating the Barrios of Santa Clara and Cunig in the Municipalities of Gonzaga and Gattaran, Respectively, Province of Cagayan

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1960/ra_2770_1960.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sitios of Maguing, Lapag, Mamanghag, Calanutan, Caronuan, Malabbeg, Hudong, Ugued, Annokugen and Marapang in the Municipality of Gonzaga, Province of Cagayan, are hereby constituted into a barrio in the same municipality to be known as the barrio of Santa Clara.
The barrio of Madarag and the sitio of Cunig in the Municipality of Gattaran, same province, are hereby constituted into a barrio in the same municipality to be known as the barrio of Cunig.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 19, 1960.
